methodology: Unmodified strict Ajv2020, inlineRefs:false; one fresh child process per candidate. Original flat JSON, same precision. Independent held-out workload per preset: 32 accepted, 32 arithmetic errors across digit positions, 8 malformed records. 10000 warmups per class; 9 batches of 8192 per class. Median milliseconds/record; compilation and preparation outside warm timing. One preparation sample. No browser helper, custom keywords, input conversion, or remote schemas. Candidates with no size reduction against their established layout baseline are screened out before this timing pass; layout-only controls retained.
pythonMethodology: Unmodified Draft202012Validator.is_valid. Same 32 accepted, 32 arithmetic errors and 8 malformed flat records as Ajv. Full workload warmup/check, followed by 7 rotating rounds over each workload. Median milliseconds/record. Schema meta-validation excluded; constructor plus first accepted validation reported separately.
gate: Size must decrease and each warm workload median in each validator must not rise. A separate 5% band describes near-ties only; it is not proof of no slowdown. Compare valid, arithmetic-invalid, and malformed workloads separately. No automatic production promotion.
